content:
Simply adjust and configure the gamma as you wish.

Important note, on 1.12.2 and 1.20.1(for strange reason), the gamma setting is not connected/related with the default brightness slider. But you still have the main GUI adjustment (keybinds are configurable)

Gamma adjustment (Toggle with <u>G</u>)

For 1.21.1, default brightness slider works too

Adding this mod in a modpack and publishing it to curseforge is highly appreciated, thanks!
